prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1066; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with symptoms consistent with concussion, including headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, difficulty concentrating, and intermittent nausea in the days after the event. Initial neurological screening showed no focal deficits, and imaging was not indicated based on clinical decision rules. A graduated symptom management plan was started with cognitive and physical rest, followed by a progressive return to school and work activities as symptoms allowed.

Over the course of care, the patient attended 26 visits. Treatment included serial symptom scale tracking, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, and cervical physical therapy for associated neck stiffness. Cognitive accommodations were coordinated with the patient's employer and educators to reduce screen time and workload during active recovery phases.

Symptoms improved steadily over the treatment period, with headache frequency and dizziness decreasing substantially. Residual mild difficulty with sustained concentration persisted early on but had largely resolved by the final visits. The patient was discharged to self-management with written return precautions and instructions to seek care promptly for any worsening symptoms.
